name: classifier
description: Assigns descriptive tags and a short abstract to a document. Reads a cleaned document and emits structured classification (tags + summary) for indexing and retrieval.

skills.name: Classify document
skills.description: Reads a document and produces 2–6 specific tags plus a 1–3 sentence summary, as a strict JSON object, for indexing and search.
examples: Tag and summarize this meeting note
Classify this transcript for the document index
